title: About me
subtitle: One person who finds the cause and takes responsibility for the result
description: I'm an IT architect. For years in a corporate environment I designed systems, rolled out automation and trained teams. Today I work solo and directly with companies — you talk to the person who does the work, not a consultant who passes your case along. I don't sell retainers or hours to fill. I sell the problem solved: the cause established, infrastructure that holds, work nobody has to click through by hand any more.

highlights.title: A failure the vendor's support couldn't find
highlights.description: A small firm's accounting and inventory system was about to miss its month-end close. The software vendor's official support couldn't find the cause — I did. On top of that, I gave the client tools to handle it herself, without calling me.

highlights.title: Training for IT teams and non-technical people
highlights.description: I ran training in AI tools and technology at a global IT company — single sessions drew up to 2,000 people. I also run monthly sessions in the Brave community.
